practicalCriteria: Every one of the 13 fields is completed, or marked not applicable with a reason in the field
Every observation row in the observations table has a date, a place and a method
Every published figure has a publisher, year, coverage and status, and no overseas or historical figure is used as a current Australian fact or in a target
Each customer segment names the decision maker, the service bought and how often it is bought
The gap links to one named segment and one named service in the business plan, and the advantage has a stated durability test
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
completionRule: assessor signs off the assembled document against the rubric; the learner receives the document on sign-off
stopWorkCriteria: not applicable: document-only lesson, no field work
